_comment: Tiered urban-pull location matching. Only EXCEPTIONS are stored; every other county defaults to [self, national_hub]. national_hub = the broad national fallback. regional_hubs map a regional metro -> the counties that fall back to it (local -> regional hub -> national). hub_self_only = hub counties that do NOT pull outward (they only ever surface their own jobs). Names are compared as location keys (app.location.keys: trimmed, casefolded).
